// diagnostic E0182

Jet.LoopIndexNamedLikeMember

`{name}` here holds each row's index, not its `{name}` member

What

`{name}` here holds each row's index, not its `{name}` member

Why

In `loop (i, item) in rows` the first name is the position of each item, so a name that is also a member of the rows reads as that member but holds a number

Fix

Take each row apart by its members with a brace head, `loop {{name}, …} in rows`, or give the index a name that is no member

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.LoopIndexNamedLikeMember: Tests/UI/loop_two_bindings_over_pairs.stderr.

Error: Jet.LoopIndexNamedLikeMember: `a` here holds each row's index, not its `a` member

    |
 10 |     loop (a, b) in pairs() { print("{a} {b.b}") }
    |           ^
 Why: In `loop (i, item) in rows` the first name is the position of each item, so a name that is also a member of the rows reads as that member but holds a number
 Fix: Take each row apart by its members with a brace head, `loop {a, …} in rows`, or give the index a name that is no member
